note: Production Rive scene uses only the supplied full-body mother and deterministic source-pixel rig layers. Segmented clothing, sleeve, cuff, palm and finger mattes are derived from the same mother image. The right thumb is a mirrored left-thumb mother-pixel fill because the mother pose occludes the right thumb. Dark/orange garment passes are restored as separate mother-pixel layers parented to the same arm bones. Continuous Image Mesh+Skin on length=1 bones shattered elbows in QA; see docs/brand/rive-complete.md and scripts/rive-complete/add-arm-meshes.py.
